source: ICPAC - 74th Greater Horn of Africa Climate Outlook Forum (GHACOF74), Kigali, 17-18 Aug 2026
region: Southern Ethiopia (with central/southern Somalia and north-eastern Kenya)
summary: Wetter-than-normal rainfall is forecast. ICPAC reports about a 90% chance of enhanced rainfall over southern Ethiopia, linked to a strengthening El Nino and a developing positive Indian Ocean Dipole.
risks: A very wet season can bring flash floods and runoff. This forecast covers the Oct-Dec season as a whole, and the rains normally end in December.
note: Entered from public ICPAC material. Confirm against the original statement and the Ethiopian Meteorological Institute before relying on it.
